title: Year-End Leave Carry-Over Rules — HR Policy Update
content: The Acme Corp HR Department clarifies the year-end carry-over rules following the updated Annual Leave Policy. Employees may carry over up to 10 days of unused annual leave to the following calendar year. Any unused leave beyond the 10-day carry-over limit is forfeited at year-end with no cash payout. There is no provision for converting excess leave to cash. Employees should plan their leave schedule with their manager early in Q3 to ensure they do not lose entitlement. This policy is consistent with the revised Annual Leave Policy v2 issued in January 2026.
